claim_scope: source-only semantic ablation before locked target evaluation

text_model.revision_policy: resolve exact Hugging Face commit once at runtime and freeze before encoding
text_model.embedding_dimension_policy: read from cached checkpoint output; never hard-code

foreground: a CT region containing ground-glass opacity
a CT region containing parenchymal opacity
background: a region without the target parenchymal opacity
aerated lung without visible target opacity
non-target background in a chest CT image
prompt_bank.aggregation: L2-normalize each prompt embedding, average within class, L2-renormalize

semantic_branch.projection: learned 1x1 convolution from 256 decoder channels to text embedding dimension
semantic_branch.semantic_logit: (z dot t1 - z dot t0) / tau

patch_auxiliary.target: decoder-grid foreground fraction from visible training masks only

variants.name: real_text
variants.description: foreground/background BiomedCLIP prototypes as defined in frozen prompt bank

variants.name: swapped_text
variants.description: same cached real prototypes with foreground/background class prototypes swapped

variants.name: random_prototypes
variants.description: two fixed normalized random vectors with the same text embedding dimension

reference.name: vision_only_segformer_b1
reference.reason: already trained with the same source split, optimizer schedule, threshold and metric implementation

pass_condition: real-text branch, swapped-text control and random-prototype control complete under matched budgets using cached text only; semantic benefit is claimed only if real text gives a repeatable gain beyond controls

semantic_claim_rule.predeclared_rule: real_text mean macro-case Dice must exceed the frozen vision-only SegFormer-B1 reference, swapped_text, and random_prototypes; real_text must also beat each comparator in at least 2 of 3 paired training seeds
semantic_claim_rule.note: This directional repeatability rule is frozen before Notebook-06 execution. It is not a formal hypothesis test.
